mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2.0% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or GDP growth rebounds above 3.0% within 3 months of trigger activation.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 3.0% signals accelerating economic activity, which historically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profit margins expand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 3.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or industrial production growth slows below 1.0% within 2 months of trigger activation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or FEDFUNDS falls below 3.5% within 3 months of trigger activation.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or UNRATE falls below 7.0% within 2 months of trigger activation.
